product.name: Walnut headset stand
product.description: The stand is walnut and holds a headset.

blocks.text: Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.
The later bill is eighty three dollars and fourteen cents every quarter.
The first parcel is $51.26. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Pine wedge is not ticked. Walnut headset stand is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.

trick.evidence_text: The marked line repeats after the first parcel at eighty three dollars and fourteen cents every quarter.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
